issue.title: Port external blogposts to wiki page to prevent linkrot
issue.body:
Dead links are bad, instead of relying on websites that can disappear anytime, the javadoc should only : 
- Have the content copied in a quoted fashion
- Link to the mockito wiki (which is git based) or a markdown page within this code repository

e.g. `Mockito` class link to this website that is not anymore available https://monkeyisland.pl/2009/01/13/subclass-and-override-vs-partial-mocking-vs-refactoring
